scope: Preserve existing scope; document Section3 mismatch

requirements.requirement: Enhance existing application; preserve behavior; no removed features or wholesale replacement

requirements.requirement: Multiple logical source files and component packages, focused responsibilities
requirements.applicabilityRationale: Package/source inventory; SRP review with concrete before/after examples

requirements.requirement: All five SOLID review points, with meaningful dependency/interface/substitution reasoning

requirements.requirement: Patterns justified by concrete problems; no unnecessary pattern scaffolding
requirements.applicabilityRationale: Actual Observer/Strategy/Command/Registry rationale; simple alternatives; code matches diagrams

requirements.requirement: Identify and rectify races, synchronization and deadlock/liveness hazards
requirements.applicabilityRationale: Exact-count/state tests; deterministic queue/cancel/failure schedules; no unsupported AB-BA claim

requirements.requirement: Guard mutable state, use standard concurrency primitives; no unsafe state exposed
requirements.applicabilityRationale: Ownership inventory; concurrent data/atomic transactions; copies; callbacks/I/O outside state locks

requirements.requirement: Real graceful JVM shutdown hook stops producers and drains/stops workers
requirements.applicabilityRationale: Child JVM invokes production hook; admitted backlog positive; bounded close/termination evidence

requirements.requirement: Add/remove crops with zero monitoring-engine/evaluation-loop changes
requirements.applicabilityRationale: Kale live demo; four extension-name tests; replacement/removal during evaluation; unchanged engine source
